# LAMMPS Input Script for Quenching SiO2

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read initial structure
data_file /structures/melt/SiO2/melt.dat
read_data ${data_file}

# Define potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF Si O

# Define settings
timestep 0.001

# NPT ensemble for quenching
fix 1 all npt temp 5000 1500 3.5 iso 0.0 0.0 3.5 tchain 3 pchain 3

# Output settings
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp density

# Run the simulation
run 1000000

# Unfix the NPT ensemble
unfix 1
